packageDocs.summary: Authentication: client providers, session management, token store, plus server route handlers and JWT verification. Client components require the AuthProvider context. Server exports mount as /api/auth/* route handlers and expect NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_API_URL (or an explicit authApiUrl prop) when hosted outside the app origin.

AuthProvider.description: Root context provider for session management. Stores tokens via token-store, refreshes on load, and exposes login/register/guestLogin/logout + session + loading state. Mount once near the app root.
notes: Pass authApiUrl only when auth routes live on another origin.

AuthGate.description: Auth-bailout wrapper: renders children while a session is being restored (or a guest session is allowed), and blocks rendering until auth resolves. Used by rose/media Providers to gate full apps.
notes: Children only render after auth state resolves; ensure AuthProvider is above it.

useAuth.description: Hook returning { session, user, login, register, guestLogin, logout, loading }. Session includes a JWT accessToken needed for protected API calls.
notes: session.accessToken is the bearer token for all authenticated APIs.

saveTokens.description: Utility: persists access + refresh tokens to localStorage under machi_access_token / machi_refresh_token.

loadTokens.description: Utility: reads the persisted token pair from localStorage.

clearTokens.description: Utility: removes the persisted token pair from localStorage.
